name: Anthony Leroy
bio: Canadian horror filmmaker merging modern SOV and found footage. Co-founder of Elytra Collective, a directorial team helmed with Josh Murphy.

credits.overview: A group of film students make an investigative documentary on an elusive serial killer.

credits.overview: A feature adaptation and expansion of the story in "bodybag" (2024).

credits.overview: Two documentarians settle into a small town and persuade a few hillbilly locals to help them find the sole survivor of a massacre.

credits.overview: A videotape capturing the final moments of an amateur urban exploration group, who break into the long abandoned home of an unsolved murder.

credits.overview: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

credits.overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

credits.overview: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

credits.title: U.V.F: Underground Video Films
credits.overview: Presented as a forbidden TV broadcast, this horror anthology revives unsettling short films from the world.

credits.overview: Thaddeus Nightingale, a bloodthirsty peasant looking to avenge the death of his family, is blessed with a blade by the gods. Armed with his new weapon, Thaddeus sets off to do battle with a very powerful necromancer, known as The Necromancer.

credits.overview: Pipes Mackenzie is a disgraced pugilist, who hopes to avenge the brutal death of his grandmother and reclaim his name, by cleaning up the streets of scum with fists blessed by the Lord.

credits.overview: Tom Hornets follows a former forensics photographer haunted by the images of his past, searching for a fresh start but soon entangled with Curtis Dombroski, a ruthless slumlord thriving amid Canada’s collapsing housing system. credits.title: Harvest Brood
credits.overview: In October 2006, the community of Briar, Alabama was terrorized by a series of gruesome killings. This film is an account of the horrors that unfolded during that fateful autumn.

credits.title: BUM
credits.overview: A freelance news crew and a hotshot reporter search for a violent vagrant and get more than they bargained for.

credits.title: Summer of Janice
credits.overview: This is a 3 hour documentary about the summer of 2024 through the eyes of independent film phenom Steven Reifsteck aka Janice.Click as he/she tours around the country meeting up with friends and shooting movies along the way.

credits.overview: Friends reunite at a local movie theatre only to discover something lurking within.

credits.overview: Nearly thirty years after the strange disappearance of a Canadian baseball team, a recovered VHS tape reveals their shocking final moments as they're hunted down by a backwoods psychopath.

credits.title: bodybag
credits.overview: An impaired driver faces his own mortality on a lonely stretch of highway.

credits.title: Dusty II: Rusty's Revenge
